entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}10 ({@dégât 1d12 + 4}) slashingdgts, and la cible is {@condition agrippé}. As an action, la cible can escape the grapple by succeeding on a {@dd 14}Force ({@skill Athlétisme}) orDextérité ({@skill Acrobaties}) check (its choice). Until this grapple ends, the thessalhydra can't use its tail pincer.

entries: The thessalhydra spits a glob of acid at a point it can see within 30 mètres of it. Each creature within 10 mètres of that point doit faire a {@dd 15}Dextérité saving throw, taking 18 ({@dégât 4d8}) aciddgts on a failed save, or half as muchdgts on a successful one.
